headline: Executive Order 13557 sets the order of officials who would lead the Department of Justice if top leaders are unavailable.
what_it_does: This order lists which Department of Justice officials would step in to act as Attorney General if the top leaders cannot serve, for example because of death, resignation, or being unable to do the job. It sets the order in which those officials would take over. No summary was provided, so the specific positions and details listed in the order are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Certain officials are placed in a set order to temporarily lead the department if higher-ranking leaders are unavailable.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed November 4, 2010; exact effective date not stated in the provided material.
